comment: Animation clips for the game (docs/design/makehuman.md, "Animation clips"): each FBX (a Mixamo skeleton, with or without its mesh) is imported, retargeted onto the game's mannequin by the MakeHumanArt commandlet with -Clips, and saved as /Game/Rim3D/Generated/Animations/<name>/A_<name>; every body plays it through its own retargeter. FBX paths are relative to the repo (game/Saved is not in Git: copy clips there) unless absolute. Mocap that stands away from the origin is first centred with tools/makehuman/clip_prep.py ("source" -> "fbx").
